verdict.rationale:
Porkbun ships an official MCP server (porkbun-docs-6, porkbun-docs-31, porkbun-probe-4) explicitly designed so users can 'ask in plain language' to register domains, edit DNS, provision hosting, and move zones — with a concrete example prompt ('Register skaboink.dev if it's under $20...', porkbun-docs-39) showing natural-language command execution across 96 tools. This is first-party but well-documented and specific to agentic/NL use cases (llms.txt, agent-setup guide).
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server reliably interprets varied natural-language requests, and community evidence of real-world NL usage beyond vendor docs.
